text:
Ava Brooks: quick design sync  compare table + filter persistence + badges. want to finalise microcopy + a11y before we flip the density toggle in beta. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/zzzz-compact-compare
Jasper Lowe: added a filter-preserve option so pinned models + selected filters persist across sessions. question: should the compare selection clear when filters change?
Mina Park: UX instinct: don't silently clear selection. show a small toast: 'Filters changed  2 models still selected' with an option 'Apply filters and keep selection' vs 'Reset selection'.
Priya Singh: accessibility: the toast must be announced by screen readers and should be focusable. Also ensure contrast of badge foreground meets 4.5:1 in compact mode. current green on pale green fails on some themes.
Leo Chen: noted on contrast. i'll tweak palette to a deeper green and run a11y color check. Also the performance badge currently uses an icon-only for status; we need visible text fallback for small sizes.
Hana Suzuki: keyboard flow: when comparing multiple rows, pressing arrow keys should move row selection focus; Enter toggles pin. currently tabbing jumps into badge tooltips because they're focusable.
Mina Park: badges aren't actionable, so they should not be in the tab order. make them aria-hidden if decorative, and expose full details via an optional details button that is tabbable.
Priya Singh: for screen readers, provide aria-label on the badge: "Throughput 210 rps; P95 latency 9 ms; meets SLO." Example: aria-label=\"Throughput 210 requests per second; p95 latency 9 milliseconds; within SLO\"
Jasper Lowe: about pinning: users expect undo. propose an inline snackbar "Version pinned. Undo" that appears near the row and is keyboard accessible. Also pin should have aria-pressed=true when active.
Ava Brooks: copy nits: badge tooltip -> shorten to 'P95 9ms  within SLO'. snackbar text -> 'Pinned version 1.2.3  Undo'. Keep aria-labels verbose.
Leo Chen: will reserve 88px for badges to avoid layout shift and add a skeleton. also will ensure the badge has role=\"status\" so screen readers pick it up when it changes.
Hana Suzuki: i'll update keyboard tests: 1) single tab per row in dense mode, 2) arrow keys to move selection, 3) Enter to open details, 4) Escape closes details and returns focus.
Priya Singh: add to a11y checklist: announce toast/snackbar, badge aria-label, pin aria-pressed, focus return after undo, color contrast validation. I'll run VO + NVDA checks after PR.
Ava Brooks: timeline: Jasper to ship Figma variants by EOD, Leo opens PR tomorrow, Hana runs keyboard tests, Priya validates a11y. thumbs? :thumbsup:
All: :thumbsup:
